name: Wind-Skimmer Raptor Will

abilities.name: Skim Step
abilities.effect: A low fast skim forward along the air, long streaks behind.

abilities.name: Cloud Veil
abilities.effect: A thin cloud wraps the holder and blurs them for a few seconds.

acquire.equipPiece: A single cyan feathered wing-vambrace on the left forearm (the only equipped piece).

abilities.name: Wingbeat Burst
abilities.effect: A downward wingbeat throws a gust ring that pushes and bruises everything near.

abilities.name: Cyclone Wake
abilities.effect: The raptor circles and leaves a cyclone in its wake that drags foes along and slows them.

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form: the whole body becomes a raptor-beastman in light feathered armor: beaked head with a feather crest, sharp amber eyes, two wing-arm vambraces with long primary feathers, a down-feather ruff, digitigrade talon greaves and a fan of long tail feathers; a feather-edged wind-talon blade forms on the right wing-arm.

equip.weapon: A long feather-edged wind-talon blade formed from the primary feathers of the right wing-arm.
equip.armor: Light white-and-blue feathered cuirass, wing-arm vambraces with long primaries and talon greaves.
equip.hair_eyes: A swept feather crest for hair, sharp amber eyes.
equip.aura: A cyan-white gale trail around the body.

lore: The will of an elder raptor that skims the top of the gale: it never lands hard, fades into clouds and falls on prey from the wind.
pitch: The Gale Skimmer is an A-class sky raptor that never lands hard and falls on prey out of the wind. Acquire keeps you human, skimming in air streaks with one cyan feathered wing-vambrace. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a raptor-beastman in feathered armor with a wind-talon blade: the best mobility, but little armor and a slightly higher drain than the wolf.
untrained: An untrained holder is thrown by their own wind: the body wobbles in mid-air, falls are not cushioned as expected and strain climbs with every dash and dive. Canon: a will that is not suppressed or balanced disrupts body and mana core and can eventually kill the holder, so the first Awakening (forced, a spark in the core) is the most dangerous moment and training both cores is the cure.

spirit.echo: A slim raptor beastman in light feathered armor: beaked head with a feather crest, sharp amber eyes, wing-arm vambraces with long primaries, digitigrade talon feet, streaming tail feathers, a wind-talon blade.
spirit.look: A bright cyan orb with drifting white feathers and thin spiral wind lines orbiting it like the eye of a storm.
